title: Peacock Goddess with Scarab
description: A teal-skinned woman with closed eyes and a slight smile is shown in profile, wearing an elaborate headdress of peacock feathers with purple and orange eyes. Her left hand is raised near her face with a golden scarab beetle on the index finger, while her right hand holds a dark circular platform featuring another scarab, golden rings, and additional peacock feathers.
prompt: Profile view of a serene teal-skinned woman with closed eyes and slight smile, wearing a large headdress made of peacock feathers with prominent purple and orange eyes. Her left hand is raised with a golden scarab beetle resting on her index finger, right hand holding a dark ornate platform containing another scarab, golden rings, and large peacock feathers. Mystical dark background with geometric lines, stars, glowing particles and smoke, fantasy digital art style.
